note: A look at panel.dock.toolbar after the screen picker gained its Storyboard view (n-0095, Topher 2026-09-21). Driven on a stamped scratch copy on 4730 (node tools/scratch.mjs new look-0921f).

results.reasoning: The open picker offers List and Storyboard. Storyboard lays the seven screens out three to a row in storyboard order, each a live frame of its as-built page scaled to the card, titled and labelled with its id and whether a design is on file; the screen the page is wears HERE. The popover widens to 660px for it and narrows back to 288px for the list. A card picks its screen the way a row does: the list closes, the frame lands on rule-detail and the bar reads it as picked. After a reload the picker reopens on the Storyboard, and List brings the rows back. The rest of the bar - project, surface, pin mode - was not re-driven here; the recorded checks on the rule cover it.
